description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn ends

Traits Paradise-Touched

You alone are returned to the state you were in at the start of your last turn: your position, your actions, and the resources you spent on it. Everything you did to the world stands — damage you dealt, effects you created, doors you opened. You then take your turn again. In practice this is a second turn with your position reset.

cinderfall.incomplete: Once/day: rewind your own last turn's position/actions/resources, keep the world-state changes, take the turn again. A full turn-state-rewind-except-external-effects mechanic has no rule-element representation; this is action-economy manipulation at a level no rule element operates at, would need a macro.
